issues.description: Candidate pairs dropped: escalate-disburse-loan-to-credit-director (role-credit-director) would name l2-approval and committee-vote-director (both role-credit-director). Those are same-role pairs, which REQ-464's shipped-definition guard (required_outputs_shipped_definitions_test, asserts zero candidate_pairs) forbids. The REQ-464 design (role_binding.ex single_member_pairs/1 and check 4) warns only when the shared role has one member, and the test asserts zero pure pairs regardless of member count. Every meridian routing role has exactly one holder in test/fixtures/uat/actors.yaml, so the design warning would fire. The guard was not edited. Residual gap: the l2 approver (julia, sole role-credit-director holder) can release via escalate-disburse-loan-to-credit-director if disburse-loan times out. BA/ORCH decision needed: either relax the guard to REQ-464's membership-aware semantics and re-add the two pairs (path is then uncompletable for julia after l2, ending in disbursement-held-notice), or accept the gap.

The REQ-464 validator's HTTP route (POST /definitions/:id/validate) reports the literal status valid, not OK. Both changed definitions return valid true and violations empty from Letflow.Definitions.validate_definition_graph/2 in the new engine tests.
